question.text: If <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi>B</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>C</mi></math> are square matrices of order <math><mn>3</mn></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced close="|" open="|" separators="|"><mi>A</mi></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mfenced close="|" open="|" separators="|"><mi>B</mi></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced close="|" open="|" separators="|"><mi>C</mi></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo></math> then the value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced close="|" open="|" separators="|"><mrow><mn>3</mn><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>a</mi><mi>d</mi><mi>j</mi><mi>A</mi></mrow></mfenced><mi>B</mi><msup><mi>C</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfenced></math> is equal to (where, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi><mi>d</mi><mi>j</mi><mi>A</mi></math> represents the adjoint matrix of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi></math>)

solution.text: 3adjABC-1=33adjA⋅BC=33×A2⋅BC=33×22×34=81
